Three rotated serial runtime rounds, nine paired blocks per condition/round, bursts 1/4. Setup, validation and serialization excluded; per-render allocation, encoding, submission and final owning copy/map/completion included. Burst4 observes only its last output. Independent CPU f64 geometry/integration plus f32 NN oracle; eager f32 Torch CPU/MPS uses the SAME ReLU prelude and stable thin alpha. Shared M4 desktop and coarse browser clock, descriptive ratios only; no isolated GPU timing, general PyTorch superiority, training or scene-quality claim. Label adaptation is temporary.

decision: Use existing pointwise shaders with immutable direct-view metadata; retain the same-submission forced-packing control and automatic fallback. This removes an allocation/dispatch, not a submission; no universal speed claim or training-path change.
